purpose: Add coordinate-coverage descriptors for the conditional T29 stop computed independently during alignment; unchanged primary and sensitivity eligibility/counting rules.
interpretation: Coverage of reference codon coordinates, not proof of an error-free coding sequence, translation, or an RNA end.
freeze_boundary_detail: Whole-genome alignment and locus-only extraction were already running. Target-junction eligibility, downstream/full-chain counts and target-read sequences had not been inspected; the original primary and sensitivity criteria remain unchanged.
